rubric_name: Final HANS RAG manual evaluation rubric

criteria.score_1: covers some but not all requested topics
some useful sources but not ideal

criteria.score_0: claims unsupported or contradicted by sources
criteria.score_2: all important claims supported by cited evidence
citations clearly placed next to supported claims

criteria.score_0: not useful as a staff draft

criteria.score_2: risk/uncertainty correctly flagged or not flagged

manual_review_sample_recommendation: Review at least 12-15 outputs across passed, partial, and failed cases, including both providers and both QA modes.
literature_alignment: RAGAS: faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision/recall
ARES: context relevance, answer faithfulness, answer relevance
G-Eval/LLM-as-judge: rubric-based qualitative assessment with human oversight
